name: Deletions Per Minute
query:
SELECT
	DATE_FORMAT(d.creation, '%%Y-%%m-%%d %%H:%%i') AS "Minute:Data:140",
	d.owner AS "Deleted By:Link/User:220",
	d.deleted_doctype AS "What:Data:180",
	COUNT(*) AS "Records:Int:90"
FROM `tabDeleted Document` d FORCE INDEX (creation)
WHERE d.creation >= %(from_date)s AND d.creation < %(to_date)s + INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 4 DESC
